hypotheses.claim: H_r5_load_saturation_ruin: On cvrp_dev_hetero_24 at 500 ms, replacing the round-4 stagnation-adaptive rank-power schedule with a fixed-p rank power (p≈1.5) amplified by a load-saturation gate (route_load/capacity)^1.5 and a mild depot-eccentricity factor, plus a capacity-slack reward in score_recreate_action, will reduce mean tour length below the portfolio SBS 16.0597 (round-4 arm was 16.0887 with the refuted schedule), with the gain concentrated in the weak regimes size=100, capacity_level=tight, depot_style=eccentric and spatial=uniform.

next_search_advice.direction: Pivot away from the refuted stagnation-adaptive rank-power schedule (H_r4_stag_adaptive_dual_gate). Instead push capacity-tightness and depot-eccentricity exploitation: (1) score_ruin_nodes = rank_power(|removal_savings|/scale, p≈1.5 fixed with tiny stagnation nudge only) multiplied by a load-saturation gate g_load = (route_load/capacity)^{beta}, beta≈1.5, so ruins preferentially attack nearly-full routes (the tight-capacity weak regime) plus a depot-eccentricity term (d(0,i)/mean_d0)^{0.5} to break clusters far from an eccentric depot; (2) score_recreate_action adds a dimensionless capacity-slack reward (remaining slack after insertion / capacity) instead of any absolute depot-distance term, keeping both hooks scale-invariant and observational-noise free. Keep the Regret-2 deterministic recreate untouched.
